title: Decide the safe U-VEND numbering route before the next vendor attempt
purpose: Review TARGET-036D2C route-discovery evidence and select a supported next step without changing setup or creating master data.
entryCriteria: TARGET-036D2C result exists and is observed.
Page Inspection proves Page 456 / Table 308 and fields Default Nos. and Manual Nos. for U-VEND read-only.
More Options row-menu evidence is treated as action inventory only, not as U-VEND value proof.

decisionOptions.useWhen: A trusted UI route can set Default Nos. on the U-VEND header with before/after/reopen proof.
Manual Nos. is deliberately chosen as the first vendor-numbering strategy.
The safest numbering route remains unclear and another W1 Foundation prerequisite can progress without vendor creation.
forbids: vendor retry while U-VEND numbering remains unresolved

stopIf: A setup write would be needed to answer the decision.
The decision would create master data or a document.
The selected route cannot explain what happens to Default Nos. or Manual Nos. after reopen.
acceptanceCriteria: The next case is selected explicitly from the D2C evidence.
The first vendor retry remains blocked unless U-VEND numbering is deliberately resolved.
No BC write, Playwright live run, master data, document, Preview Posting or Posting occurs in D2D.

proved: Business Central stayed in playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE.
U-VEND was inspected read-only on Number Series Page 456.
No setup, master data, document, Preview Posting, Posting, payment, API shortcut or company switch occurred.
At least one route signal was visible enough for a follow-up route-decision case.
Page Inspection exposed the No. Series page/table and field identifiers read-only; this is a technical field-list proof, not a U-VEND value proof.
notProved: U-VEND Standardnr. / Default Nos. is not proven active.
Manual Nos. / Manuelle Anz. is not changed or proven active.
Page Inspection does not prove a persisted U-VEND checkbox value in this read-only case.
The More Options row-menu screenshot is not a U-VEND value proof because Business Central can move list focus while opening row menus.
No vendor creation retry is allowed from this case alone.
No legal numbering, posting group, VAT, payment term, document, Preview Posting or Posting behavior is proven.
warnings: D2C is read-only and must not be treated as a setup-fit proof.
Checkbox grid values on Business Central lists need a route with row/field certainty before any write.
Screenshot QA must distinguish selected-row proof from general action/menu inventory; row focus can drift on Business Central lists.

nextStepDecisionCard.lastEvidenceSummary: TARGET-036D2C proved U-VEND read-only on Number Series Page 456 and Page Inspection mapped Table 308 fields Default Nos. and Manual Nos.; it did not change setup or prove either checkbox active.
nextStepDecisionCard.reason: Vendor retry is still blocked because U-VEND numbering is unresolved. Since the planned first vendor number is U-VEND-100, Microsoft Learn supports Manual Nos. as the deliberate next numbering strategy; setup must be fitted before vendor creation.

lookaheadReviewed.reason: Smallest source-backed write: enable Manual Nos. only for U-VEND with before/after/reopen proof. No vendor is created in this case.
Retry becomes sensible only after U-VEND Manual Nos. is visibly active after reopen.
Item creation should wait until the vendor-numbering blocker is closed or explicitly parked.
Useful after numbering route closure to re-check foundation blockers before broader master data.

nextStepDecisionCard.whySelectedNextCaseIsBest: It resolves the specific first-vendor blocker with one narrow, source-backed setup field that matches the intended readable vendor number U-VEND-100, while keeping Standard Nos., master data, drafts, Preview and Posting locked.
risksBeforeNextCase: Do not toggle Standardnr. / Default Nos. in the manual-numbering case.
Do not create the vendor in D2E.
Do not change number-series lines or other number series.
Do not use row-menu screenshots as value proof without selected-row QA.
requiredPreparation: Use Page 456 U-VEND selected-row proof before write.
Use Liste bearbeiten or another explicit edit affordance only if the U-VEND row and Manual Nos. cell are both mapped.
Capture before, after and reopen screenshots plus Page Inspection/field context if needed.

result: Manual Nos. is the selected source-backed next route for the planned readable first vendor number U-VEND-100; no BC write was done in D2D.
proved: D2D did not change Business Central data.
D2C Page Inspection mapped U-VEND on Page 456 / Table 308 and fields Default Nos. and Manual Nos.
Microsoft Learn supports Manual Nos. as the route for allowing users to enter numbers manually.
The next vendor retry remains blocked until U-VEND Manual Nos. is active after reopen proof.
notProved: U-VEND Manual Nos. / Manuelle Anz. is not yet active.
U-VEND Default Nos. / Standardnr. is not active and is not selected as the next write target.
No Vendor Posting Group, VAT group, payment term, document, Preview Posting or Posting behavior is proven.
No final legal numbering or accounting compliance claim is made.
warnings: D2E must not repeat coordinate or untrusted DOM checkbox routes.
D2E may only change Manual Nos. for U-VEND if row and field are both confidently mapped.
Standard Nos. remains a separate later decision for automatic numbering.
